finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1000 Cr, EBITDA margin = 20%, Debt = ₹300 Cr, Interest rate = 9%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 15%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹200 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹27 Cr = ₹173 Cr.
New revenue = ₹850 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹170 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹143 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-30 Cr — notice how a 15% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
